stance_basis: paraphrased as having taken administrative/funding actions enabling project elements without expressing support or opposition
summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is mentioned in a factual, administrative capacity: it redesignated the Harbor Freeway as an interstate highway (enabling Federal funding for an HOV/bus facility) and approved construction of I-105 with a transitway. The Department also approved proceeding with preliminary engineering on Elements I, II, and III of the Regional Transit Development Program in December 1976, while stipulating that SCRTD complete environmental review. No opinion for or against the overall project is expressed.
complaint_summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation redesignated the Harbor Freeway as an interstate highway, making eligible for Federal funding an 8-mile HOV/bus facility between Adams Boulevard and I-105, and authorized PE/EIS work; it also approved I-105 (Century Freeway) for construction with a transitway in its median.
summary_quote: The U. S. Department of Transportation has redesignated the Harbor Freeway as an interstate highway, thereby making eligible for Federal funding assistance an 8-mile HOV/bus facility between Adams Boulevard and I-105 and PE/EIS work has been authorized.
